snippet.title: Val's Adventures at Scure Manor - Trailer
snippet.description:
"Val's Adventures at Scure Mansion" is a point-and-click game, featuring the story of Val, a young Italian man who arrives home at 3 am, only to realize that he has lost his key. Val must thoroughly explore his surroundings, utilizing found items cleverly, to gain entry and make it to bed on time before his alarm rings.


Coming soon.

Music:
Mild Noctivagation by Eduardo Balbuena.
Hip Hop Rock Beats_Chime by QubeSounds
